items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: He played with me a while

ctx.x: Got everything I've done up here man.
Yeah. Well we've been talking to you you know. What about Earl Fusche? Did you ever know him?

Yeah. Pretty good saxophone player. He played with me a while but he's another fella with a big head that couldn't get along with him. Thought he was going to saxophone player in town. I don't know what he'd come up in.
